## Board of Directors - Minutes Q2 2025

Strictly confidential

## 1. Attendance and quorum

Meeting held on 22 July 2025 at Tampere Works, Finland. Present: Maria Peltoniemi, Margareta Lindqvist (Chair), Henrik Aalto, Dr. Ines Carvalho, Pieter van Dam, Valdemar Peltonen. Also in attendance: Ilari Pesonen (COO) and Anne Laakkonen (General Counsel, secretary to the board). Quorum was confirmed.

The minutes of the previous meeting were approved without amendment.

## 2. Financial performance

The CFO reported Q2 FY2025 revenue of EUR 99.9 million against a budget of EUR 97.6 million, with an adjusted EBITDA margin of 15.5% and cash of EUR 46.5 million.

Order intake for the quarter was EUR 108.3 million, giving a book-to-bill ratio of 1.08.

| KPI | Q2 FY2025 | Budget |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue | EUR 99.9m | EUR 97.6m |
| EBITDA margin | 15.5% | 14.5% |
| LTIFR | 0.51 | 0.70 |
| On-time delivery | 89.5% | 93.0% |

## 3. Resolutions

The Board approved the opening of a sales office in Stockholm in Q3 2026.

The Board noted the ISO 9001 surveillance audit passed with zero major findings.

The next meeting is scheduled for 21 October 2025.
